metaDescription: Answers to common questions about working with GrowZap — pricing, contracts, SEO timelines,

items.a: GrowZap is a full-service digital marketing agency offering SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media management, content writing, graphic design, and video editing — built to work together as a connected strategy rather than disconnected services.

items.q: What industries do you work with?
items.a: We work across multiple industries, including home services, healthcare, ecommerce, professional services, real estate, and hospitality. [See Industries We Serve →]

items.q: Where is GrowZap located, and who do you serve?
items.a: GrowZap is rooted in Colorado and Montana, and we serve businesses across the USA, both locally-focused and nationally-focused.

items.q: How much does it cost to work with GrowZap?
items.a: Pricing depends on which services and scope you need. We offer tiered packages designed for small business budgets — see our Pricing page for a general overview, or book a free consultation for a specific quote.

items.q: How long does SEO take to show results?
items.a: Most businesses see meaningful movement within 3–6 months, with results building further over 6–12 months, depending on your starting point and competition. [Learn more about SEO Services →]

items.q: Can you guarantee a #1 Google ranking?
items.a: No legitimate agency can guarantee a specific ranking position. We commit to transparent strategy, consistent execution, and honest reporting instead.

items.q: Is my ad spend included in your management fee?
items.a: No — ad spend is paid directly to Google or Meta and is separate from our management fee, which covers strategy, setup, and ongoing optimization. [Learn more about Google Ads →] [Learn more about Meta Ads →]

items.q: How fast can paid ads generate leads?
items.a: Campaigns can begin generating clicks and leads within days of launch, though meaningful optimization typically takes a few weeks of performance data.

items.q: What happens after I book a consultation?
items.a: We'll discuss your business, goals, and current marketing situation, then typically follow up with a free audit relevant to the service(s) you're interested in before recommending a specific strategy.

items.q: Do I need to know exactly which services I need before reaching out?
items.a: No — many clients aren't sure which services fit best when they first reach out. That's part of what the initial consultation is for.
